narr: Scattered storms developed in a warm, humid airmass to the south of a stalled frontal boundary over southern New York state during the late afternoon and early evening of August 27, 2021. A couple of these storms produced wind damage in the Lower Susquehanna Valley. Flash flooding was also reported in Tioga County near Mansfield.
ev: Water was reported over the road near US 6 and Roseville Road.
